technique_name: Compare the features of two e-commerce platforms
description: Shopify and BigCommerce are two popular e-commerce platforms. Shopify is a cloud-based, self-hosted platform that allows users to easily build an online store and manage their products. It offers a comprehensive set of features and is highly customizable, allowing users to design their store and create unique customer experiences. BigCommerce is also a cloud-based platform, but it is a fully hosted solution, meaning that all store management, hosting, and security is managed directly by BigComme
